🚨 PLEASE DO NOT DO THIS! ⬇️⬇️⬇️

1️⃣ Skipping Regular Maintenance 🛠️🚫Ignoring small issues like leaks or skipping HVAC servicing? That’s a recipe for BIGGER (and more expensive) problems later! Fix it now, save $$$ later.

2️⃣ Overpersonalizing Your Space 🎨❌Your bold colors & unique decor might be your vibe, but not every buyer will love it. Stick to neutral tones & classic styles for max appeal!

3️⃣ Ignoring Curb Appeal 🌿🏡First impressions matter! Overgrown yard, peeling paint, or a dull exterior can turn buyers away before they even step inside. Keep it fresh & inviting!

4️⃣ DIY Disasters 🪚😬We love a good DIY moment, but bad craftsmanship can cost you big time! For major upgrades, trust the pros—your home (and wallet) will thank you.

5️⃣ Overlooking Energy Efficiency 💡💰Buyers love energy-efficient homes! Upgrading windows, insulation, & appliances not only helps the planet 🌍 but also boosts your home’s value.
